top_signals.title: OPEC+ Faces Growing Pressure As Iraq Pushes for Higher Quota
top_signals.summary: Iraq is negotiating with OPEC for permission to produce more oil, Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair said Friday, arguing that the country needs a higher production ceiling to develop its energy infrastructure. The request comes ahead of Sunday's OPEC+ meetings on production policy for 2027. For now, Iraq isn't likely to get what it wants. Three sources told Reuters that OPEC+ members have agreed in principle to leave their production quotas unchanged for the first quarter of 2027. top_signals.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
top_signals.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Attackers Used Optimizely to A/B Test Malware on Top Websites
top_signals.summary: At least 178 top web destinations unwittingly served a variety of malware exploits against visitors over the past 24 hours thanks to a security vulnerability involving Optimizely, a company that helps websites customize user experiences and test out new features. Experts say the incident, which saw data-stealing malicious software silently injected into sites like the BBC, CNN, Equifax, Ledger and Zoom, was exacerbated by the reality that few popular websites enforce strict rules on the sources of third-party content.

top_signals.title: Outdoor Recreation Economic Statistics, U.S. and States, 2025
top_signals.summary: The value added of the outdoor recreation economy accounted for 2.3 percent ($704.2 billion) of current-dollar gross domestic product (GDP) for the nation in 2025. Across states and the District of Columbia, value added for outdoor recreation as a share of state GDP ranged from 6.1 percent in Hawaii to 1.0 percent in the District of Columbia.

alerts.title: Hydropower generation in the Southwest fell to record lows this summer
alerts.summary: Prolonged drought conditions affecting the Colorado River Basin led to record low hydropower generation this summer in the Southwestern electricity supply region, which includes Arizona, New Mexico, and small parts of Nevada and California. Hydropower generation from April through August 2026 was 19% lower than during the same period last year and 28% lower than the 10-year average, according to the latest data from our Form EIA-923 survey
